Irene — draft technical notes below (summary first, then specifics for each marketplace). I'll attach isolation diagram and metering CSV after review.

Summary: Redwood offers a unified serving runtime. For marketplace listings we support three deployment modalities depending on the marketplace:
- AWS: AMI/EC2-backed instances for Dedicated marketplace listings, or container-based SaaS behind PrivateLink for SaaS listings. Tenant isolation is achieved via dedicated VPCs for enterprise purchases (private offer) or strong namespace isolation with multi-tenant runtime + per-customer encryption keys for standard SaaS.
- Azure: VM scale sets or AKS-based manifests depending on SKU; Private Link for VNet peering in enterprise listings.
- GCP: GKE/autopilot or Marketplace SaaS integration using Cloud Run; customer-project-scoped service accounts and VPC-SC where required.

Metering & reporting:
- We expose per-customer token and inference-unit usage via a daily meter export (CSV) and an hourly push webhook for high-volume partners. Fields: date, account_id (marketplace_sku_id), model_id, request_type (chat/embed), tokens_in, tokens_out, inference_units, cost_usd (calculated).
- For marketplace reconciliations we can map internal account_id to marketplace entitlements (SKU mapping) and produce a monthly invoice bundle or per-transaction report depending on marketplace requirements.

Data flow & isolation notes:
- KV cache and model artifacts never cross tenant boundaries; for dedicated deployments we mount customer-specific volumes and KMS keys.
- For public SaaS listings we support optional per-customer encryption-at-rest keys (KMS) and strict IAM roles for access.

I'll finalize the CSV spec (metering-specs.csv) and attach the architecture diagram (isolation-arch-diagram.png) for the consolidated RFI.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachment placeholders: isolation-arch-diagram.png; metering-specs.csv

Thank you — quick legal/commercial guidance for the RFI package: 

1) Marketplace commercial terms: we should provide a short note describing typical marketplace revenue-share models we accept (standard % range), and indicate flexibility for enterprise private offers. Avoid committing to SLA credits in the RFI; state that SLA terms are governed by the Marketplace listing T&Cs and our routing to Redwood Dedicated has SLA options negotiable in the order form.

2) Indemnity & data: do not promise broad indemnities. Provide our standard marketplace addendum language and a pointer to our privacy/data processing addendum (DPA).

3) Evidence: include Redwood-SOC2-Summary.pdf (redacted) and a link to the auditor's scope. For on-prem or air-gapped options, note that audit evidence may require an NDA and separate attestation.

4) Billing & entitlements: recommend we offer both SKU-level monthly reconciliation (CSV) and an API webhook; call out how marketplace SKUs map to our internal meter (include sample mapping in the CSV).

I reviewed Karthik's technical points — please ensure that any claims about VPC peering/PrivateLink include the typical networking prerequisites (customer-side routing, peering approvals) to avoid scope creep.

I'll prepare a 1-page legal summary to include in the package.

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal
Redwood Inference

Hi Samantha — thanks for the RFI. Attached is a consolidated package that addresses the sections you requested: technical deployment isolation (diagram), metering/export spec (CSV), billing and SKU mapping guidance, and our compliance summary. Highlights below:

- Deployment isolation: we support Dedicated (customer VPC / dedicated instances), Private SaaS (PrivateLink/Private Endpoint), and standard multi-tenant SaaS with per-customer encryption and strict RBAC. See attached isolation-arch-diagram.png for the high-level topologies per marketplace.
- Metering: attached metering-specs.csv; we deliver daily CSV exports and optional hourly webhook pushes. The CSV maps marketplace_sku_id to internal account IDs and includes tokens_in/out and inference_units.
- Billing & entitlements: we can provide SKU-level monthly reconciliation files or integrate via the marketplace billing connector where supported. Typical rev-share is handled through the marketplace; for private offers we can accept a standard reseller arrangement — Laura's team included a short legal note in the package.
- Compliance evidence: Redwood-SOC2-Summary.pdf is included (redacted). Full auditor reports or deeper evidence available under NDA for on-prem/air-gapped requirements.

Attachments: RFI_Answers_Redwood_Marketplace_20261015.pdf; isolation-arch-diagram.png; metering-specs.csv; Redwood-SOC2-Summary.pdf

If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute follow-up with Karthik and Laura next week to walk through any technical or contract questions before your shortlist deadline. Proposed times: Tue Oct 20 09:00-11:00 PT or Wed Oct 21 13:00-15:00 PT.

Best,
